notes.title: Single Player Update Coming
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350512/1c814fc96d6871e5f1285088694b1a514db084fe.png[/img]
[h1]What is this new update?[/h1]

The most dangerous specimens collected for research are held in an area with no connection to the rest of the station. Having to take a shuttle to and from the facility has been complained about from the beginning but right now it makes perfect sense.

One of the alien specimen have awakened and broken free and is killing everyone in its path. Your only hope is to space it. Preferably without joining it. There is a safe room where you can lock yourself in while spacing the rest of the research area. Any potential survivors will get spaced as well but at least you'll be safe! It requires the activation of several overrides in order to open the safe room door, and they are scattered all over the area. Because of course they are.

Avoid getting seen and cornered by the alien. Disable doors for temporary security while you finish your tasks. You might want to ignore the dying screams of your co-workers as well.

[h1]How far away from release is it?[/h1]
Work is getting done at a good pace. It's just weeks away!

notes.title: Update Jan 10
notes.notes: Updated options menu with more settings and working better. There is now a temporal upscaling for render resolution making the game run on a toaster!

notes.title: Patch 1.11 Hide 'n' Sneak
notes.notes:
Holiday greetings and a happy new year!
Time for a little update.

[list]
[*] Updated the Laboratory with more places for the Saboteur to hide.
[*] Made the security cameras behave more like cameras.
[*] The space station is no longer floating immovable in the stillness of space but actually rotating.

[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Nov 20
notes.notes: Updated the main map with more visuals and fixed several bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Not everyone wants to play with six other players so we have added a new small 3 player map. While the seven player experience is still the gold standard you can now enjoy the game with lesser parties.

Also made several performance optimizations.
